name: tekthib
description: Tunisian Online Card Game - A real-time multiplayer bluffing card game

scripts.install:client: npm run install:shared && cd client && npm ci --prefer-offline
scripts.install:server: npm run install:shared && cd server && npm ci --prefer-offline --include=dev
scripts.install:all: npm run install:shared && npm run install:client && npm run install:server
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.deploy:collector: git subtree push --prefix data_collector heroku-data-collector main
scripts.lint: cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint
scripts.format: cd server && npm run format && cd ../client && npm run format
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm run install:server && npm run build:server && npm run cleanup

author: Chater Marzougui
